title: Concept: PostgreSQL error detail disclosed in a response
description: A PostgreSQL authentication failure naming the role in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message names a live database role, which is the first half of a credential guess and confirms the role exists.
applicability: Deployments that render a PostgreSQL authentication failure naming the role into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message names a live database role, which is the first half of a credential guess and confirms the role exists.
